profile.visual_desc: Human in thick red hooded robes with blue trim and a grey under-tunic. Face is hidden in shadow within the hood.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Shadowed face within a deep red hood featuring narrow, glowing yellow eyes and a prominent nose.
profile.weapon_desc: Wooden shepherd's crook staff held in the right hand.
profile.step1_ready: Stands facing down-right; right hand holds staff low while the left hand is raised in a spell-casting gesture.
profile.step2_windup: Raises staff high and extends the left arm. The crook of the staff begins to glow with golden light.
profile.step3_impact: Holds staff aloft as a vertical pillar of golden energy erupts from the ground in front of the caster.
profile.step4_finish: Maintains the raised staff pose as the ground-based energy pillar fades into small orange sparks.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The energy effect is a vertical pillar erupting from the ground, matching the magical activation of the raised staff.

evaluation.diagnosis: Sequence matches reference pose progression and effect timing. Character orientation and magical activation are consistent.
